verdict.rationale: Phaser is scripted in JavaScript/TypeScript with full TypeScript type definitions and IDE (VSCode) integration, and community testimony describes it as easy to learn and fully-featured, supporting productive access to the engine API (phaser-gh-1, phaser-docs-4/31/33, phaser-comm-3/7/10). However, no evidence explicitly addresses a dedicated debugger/breakpoint tooling story, and some community feedback flags weak documentation, awkward TS layering (via DefinitelyTyped) and dependency/design friction that undercut 'fully exposes the API' cleanly (phaser-comm-8, phaser-comm-12, phaser-comm-16). Missing for 10: explicit debugger/devtools integration evidence, and stronger independent confirmation that the JS/TS API surface is complete without workarounds.
